name: Occupancy Grid Update
definition: Periodically refreshes a 3D occupancy grid using the current neural network's density predictions to accelerate ray marching by skipping empty space.
summary: Occupancy Grid Update periodically refreshes a 3D occupancy grid by querying a NeRF for density at voxel centers and marking occupied voxels, distinguishing itself by directly evaluating the neural network on a regular lattice rather than casting rays.
